title: SSRF via URL fetch features
summary: Prove the server fetches attacker-controlled URLs with Interactsh, not Canarytokens.
steps: Locate webhook/import/proxy/preview/url params from the map.
execute_interactsh(args='register') — take payload_url (and payload_email for mail/webhooks).
Plant payload_url in one URL-fetch field (mutate_captured_request or compare_requests).
Then compare_requests benign URL vs in-scope canary for an internal HTTP body.
Do not use canarytokens.org or an operator inbox. Never 169.254.169.254 / localhost if Lictor blocks.
On PASS: poll interaction and/or internal content in the response with request evidence.
kill_signals: Allowlist blocks; poll empty; no internal bleed
